title: User Login
description: The system shall authenticate a registered user using a valid email and password, establish an authenticated session, identify the user's role, and redirect the user to the appropriate authorized area.
rationale: Authentication is required to access personal academic information.
acceptance_criteria: Valid credentials successfully log in; invalid credentials are rejected.

title: View Available Courses
description: The system shall allow an authenticated student to browse available course sections and filter the catalogue using the student's academic program so that only eligible/open offerings are presented.
rationale: Students need to find courses relevant to their program.
acceptance_criteria: Only open and program-relevant course sections are displayed.

title: View Class Information
description: For each displayed course section, the system shall provide the course/class information needed for a registration decision, including course name/code, lecturer, schedule, room, capacity/availability, fee and section status.
rationale: Students need sufficient information before registration.
acceptance_criteria: All required class information is displayed correctly.

title: Register for a Class
description: The system shall allow an authenticated student to submit a registration request for an available course section and create a confirmed registration only after all mandatory validation rules pass.
rationale: Course registration is the main purpose of the system.
acceptance_criteria: A student can successfully register for an eligible open class.

title: Prevent Schedule Conflict
description: Before confirming registration, the system shall compare the selected section's day/time with the student's existing confirmed registrations and reject the request when time intervals overlap; adjacent intervals where one ends exactly when another starts shall not conflict.
rationale: Preventing schedule conflicts avoids invalid study schedules.
acceptance_criteria: Registration is rejected when two confirmed class time periods overlap on the same day.

title: Check Class Capacity
description: The system shall verify the section's current enrollment against its configured capacity at registration time and reject the request when no seat remains.
rationale: Class size must remain within the assigned capacity.
acceptance_criteria: Registration is rejected when enrolled count is greater than or equal to class capacity.

title: View Registered Classes
description: The system shall allow an authenticated student to view the student's own registered classes, including registration status and relevant course/section details.
rationale: Students need to review their academic schedules.
acceptance_criteria: All confirmed registrations are displayed with correct class information.

title: Cancel Registration
description: The system shall allow a student to cancel an eligible own registration and shall update the registration state and available-seat/enrollment information consistently.
rationale: Students may need to change their study plans.
acceptance_criteria: A registered student can cancel the registration and the class seat becomes available.

title: Create Class
description: The system shall allow an authorized administrator to create a course section by entering and validating required course, lecturer, schedule, room, capacity, fee, semester and status information.
rationale: Administrators need to publish classes for student registration.
acceptance_criteria: A valid class can be created and displayed to students.

title: Edit Class Information
description: The system shall allow an authorized administrator to edit permitted course-section attributes and persist the updated values after validation, while preventing unauthorized users from modifying administrative data.
rationale: Academic information may need to be corrected or updated.
acceptance_criteria: Authorized administrators can update valid class information successfully.

title: Notify Students of Class Cancellation
description: When an administrator cancels a section, the system shall identify affected registered students and create a cancellation notification for each affected student.
rationale: Students need to know about changes affecting their registered classes.
acceptance_criteria: Every affected student receives a cancellation notification.

title: User Role Management
description: The system shall enforce role-based permissions for student, lecturer and administrator operations and shall prevent a user from invoking functions outside the user's assigned role.
rationale: Different users require different system access levels.
acceptance_criteria: Students, lecturers, and administrators can only access authorized functions.

title: View Notifications
description: The system shall provide an authenticated user with a notification list containing notifications addressed to that user, with sufficient information to understand the event and its current read/status state.
rationale: Users need to review important system updates.
acceptance_criteria: Notifications are displayed with correct content and read status.

title: Maintain Registration Data
description: The system shall persist registration changes atomically so that registration records, section enrollment counts and related notifications do not remain in an inconsistent partial state after a successful or failed transaction.
rationale: Registration records are required for academic management.
acceptance_criteria: Registration data remains available after logout and application restart.

title: Student Account Registration
description: The system shall allow a new student to create an account using required identity credentials and shall reject duplicate unique identifiers such as email or student code.
rationale: Students require an account before using personal registration services.
acceptance_criteria: A new student with unique email and student code is created with role student and is logged in after registration.

title: User Logout
description: The system shall allow an authenticated user to log out and terminate the active authenticated session so that protected resources cannot be accessed using the terminated session.
rationale: Users need a secure way to end their session.
acceptance_criteria: After logout the session no longer contains user_id and the user is redirected to the landing page.

title: Protect Authenticated Routes
description: The system shall protect authenticated pages and APIs from anonymous access and shall require the appropriate role for administrative and role-scoped operations.
rationale: Personal academic information must not be accessible anonymously.
acceptance_criteria: A request without a valid session is rejected with HTTP 401 or redirected to login as designed.

title: View Student Dashboard
description: The system shall display a student dashboard summarizing relevant information such as registered classes and other student-specific registration information available to the application.
rationale: Students need a quick overview of their registration status.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays the logged-in student and their confirmed registrations.

title: View Student Profile
description: The system shall allow an authenticated student to view the student's own profile information and shall prevent the student from accessing another user's private profile through student self-service functions.
rationale: Students need to verify their stored account information.
acceptance_criteria: Profile page displays the current user information without exposing another user's account.

title: Prevent Duplicate Registration
description: The system shall reject an attempt to register the same student in the same course section more than once.
rationale: Duplicate registrations would corrupt schedules and enrollment counts.
acceptance_criteria: A duplicate registration attempt is rejected and no additional registration record is created.

title: Validate Program Eligibility
description: The system shall verify that the selected course belongs to, or is otherwise permitted for, the student's academic program before confirming registration.
rationale: Students should only register for courses offered to their program.
acceptance_criteria: A course from a different program is rejected with a clear validation message.

title: Reject Registration for Closed Class
description: The system shall reject registration when the selected course section is closed, cancelled or otherwise not open for student registration.
rationale: Closed or cancelled sections must not accept new registrations.
acceptance_criteria: Any section whose status is not open is rejected before a registration record is created.

title: Update Enrollment Count
description: After a successful registration, the system shall increase the section's enrollment count exactly once; after a rejected/rolled-back transaction, the count shall remain unchanged.
rationale: Enrollment statistics must remain consistent with confirmed registrations.
acceptance_criteria: A successful registration increases enrolled_count by one; a rejected registration does not increase it.

title: View Assigned Teaching Sections
description: The system shall allow a lecturer to view only the course sections assigned to that lecturer, including the associated teaching schedule and class information.
rationale: Lecturers need access to their teaching timetable and class enrollment summary.
acceptance_criteria: The lecturer API returns only sections where lecturer_id equals the logged-in lecturer, including room, schedule, enrolled count and capacity.

title: View Administration Statistics
description: The system shall provide authorized administrators with registration/class statistics and return counts calculated from current persisted data.
rationale: Administrators need a basic operational overview.
acceptance_criteria: The admin statistics endpoint returns current counts for users, courses and sections and rejects non-admin users.

title: Create Registration Confirmation Notification
description: After a successful registration, the system shall create a confirmation notification for the registering student as part of the successful registration workflow.
rationale: Students should receive confirmation that registration succeeded.
acceptance_criteria: After a successful registration a notification record is stored for the student containing a success title and course information.
